landform: Topographic Position Index-Based Landform Classification

Source: R/landform-package.R
landform-package.Rd

Classifies a landscape into slope-position or landform classes on the basis of the Topographic Position Index (TPI) and slope (Weiss 2001; Jenness 2006).

Details

Main functions:

  • landform: Slope Position and Landform classifications, returned as an object with print, summary and plot methods;

  • tpi: the TPI surface itself, raw or standardised;

  • class_layers: one presence/absence layer per class;

  • malta_dtm: a sample digital terrain model.
